independent_oracle.tool: OpenJPEG CLI 2.5.3; system library, fixtures only
independent_oracle.qcc_note: Independent canonical QCD-before-QCC pixels are the oracle for equivalent reversed orders. Some OpenJPEG versions have the reverse-order defect; that decode is not used as reference.

benchmark.method: Rust1.91 release, jpeg2000 only for paired legacy; 8 longer alternating pairs, reverse initial order, one CPU; original unchanged jpeg2000_verify, 100 warmups. EX absolute only, 10 warmups. 2ms sampling of post-exec /proc VmHWM excludes Python/launcher pre-exec memory; raw wait4 peak is also retained but is not the decode peak metric. Parent is pinned away from the measured CPU.

targeted_rgb_repeat.method: Third repeat only for unresolved small RGB case; same pinned CPU, 8 alternating pairs, 15000 calls/process

memory.note: Build cgroup peak includes caches/other task processes. Runtime measurements sample post-exec VmHWM every2ms. Initial wait4 peaks include pre-exec Python launch memory and are retained only as raw data, not interpreted as decode peaks.
